dryRun.method: Six SQL migrations inside transaction on canonical production Supabase, then ROLLBACK

productionBaselineEvidence: verified: canonical GitHub main SHA 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c and read-only BUKLOD Connect Supabase 2026-11-11: 306 qualified QMP users across 3 periods; 148 missing Finance links; 214 Finance links, 0 cash ledger credits, 0 settled Finance months, all payout/settlement/economics flags OFF. Six migration dry-run in BEGIN/ROLLBACK reached 362 links, 0 unlinked, exact QMP denominator parity and immutability guard pass; rollback reconfirmed unchanged production. No OTA runtime/RC fingerprint certified.
chosenApproach: Build an additive authenticated monthly history reader; rewire canonical Finance V3 user pool to the existing verified period-scoped Community QMP accounts; idempotently create/repair safe Finance identity links, keep legacy Community/R38 payout paths retired, and introduce fail-closed month-close/admin evidence review gates. Leave actual money activation and production OTA for the single consolidated release.
selectionRationale: The current Finance V3 has an unrelated BP ledger and personal revenue activation threshold that makes 306 qualified QMP users unequal. Reusing the existing canonical PF cash and payout ledger with one consistent monthly QMP denominator avoids dual cash creation and preserves funded reserves, withdrawal idempotency and last-month history.
alternativeApproaches: Use lifetime BP/rank to distribute cash: rejected because early high-point users would dominate permanently, contrary to monthly fairness.
Create a second cash wallet solely for Community estimates: rejected because it would double-count AdMob revenue, bypass funding and break existing PF payouts.
Reuse canonical Finance V3 cash and one monthly QMP denominator with safe identity reconciliation, server period freeze and admin review: chosen.
